cases.name: paper_sem_nex64_4800s
cases.note: Paper SEM cost anchor: cheapest SPECFEM mesh passing 0.995 on all 36 N/Z components vs the NEX320 reference at hdur80. 24 ranks on one shared node; 0.147 node-h as billed (node-h = tasks*cpus/256 x solver wall hours).
cases.source: AK135 Mrr CMT, stock SPECFEM quasi-Heaviside, half_duration=80s

cases.name: paper_sem_nex96_4800s

cases.source: AK135 Mrr CMT, stock SPECFEM quasi-Heaviside, half_duration=80s

cases.name: target_nex75_sem320_4800s
